ai_analysis.problem: The fixed overlay is always visible, regardless of loading state. This significantly degrades performance and provides a persistent, distracting visual element, especially on slower devices.
ai_analysis.original_code:
v-if="isLoading"
class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center"
ai_analysis.fixed_code:
v-if="isLoading"
class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center transition-opacity duration-300 ease-in-out"
ai_analysis.explanation: Adding `transition-opacity duration-300 ease-in-out` allows the overlay to fade in and out smoothly, mitigating the performance impact of constant rendering and providing a better user experience.  The overlay is only active if isLoading is true.
ai_analysis.fix_diff:
--- original
+++ fixed
@@ -14 +14 @@
- v-if="isLoading"
+ v-if="isLoading"
+ class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center transition-opacity duration-300 ease-in-out"

ui_accessibility_analysis.problem: The `optionCard` element lacks appropriate ARIA attributes to define its role and accessibility behavior, particularly for keyboard navigation and screen reader interpretation. This makes the dynamic content inaccessible to users with disabilities.
ui_accessibility_analysis.original_code:
v-for="option in optionList" :key="index"
class="option-card"
:class="{ active: expandedOption === option.type }"
@click="toggleOption(option.type, option.id)
:ref="'optionCard' + index"
ui_accessibility_analysis.fixed_code:
v-for="option in optionList" :key="option.id"
class="option-card"
:class="{ active: expandedOption === option.type }"
@click="toggleOption(option.type, option.id)
:ref="'optionCard' + index"
aria-controls="option.id + accordionContent" aria-expanded="expandedOption === option.type"
ui_accessibility_analysis.explanation: Adding `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded` attributes correctly defines the role of the `optionCard` element as a collapsible section, enabling screen readers to navigate and understand its state. The key is linked to a dynamically created content id.
ui_accessibility_analysis.fix_diff:
--- original
+++ fixed
@@ -85 +85 @@
- v-for="option in optionList" :key="index"
+ v-for="option in optionList" :key="option.id"
+ aria-controls="option.id + accordionContent" aria-expanded="expandedOption === option.type"

visual_simulation.layout_assessment: The visual layout appears consistent but the loader overlay should fade in and out smoothly, and the dynamically created accordion sections must be navigable using screen readers.
recommendations: Implement smooth transitions for the loader overlay.
Thoroughly test with screen readers to ensure dynamic content is fully accessible.
